references.text: Continuation of the law concerning seed: if water falls on the seed and a dead animal falls on it, it becomes unclean - this expands on the principle from verse 37
Deals with uncleanness through contact with dead bodies, the same theme regarding carrion and impurity
Refers to animals that died naturally and how the Israelites were to handle carrion
Paul uses the image of seed that must die to receive new life, a spiritual application of the principle of seed and death
